proposal.name: fast-uri
proposal.rationale: fast-uri 3.1.9 exists in npm registry (E1) and is returned when queried with spec 3.1.9 (E3). It has the highest probability (0.588) among candidates. The version was declared in the SBOM and is a valid published version.

proposal.name: brace-expansion
proposal.rationale: Version 1.1.21 has the highest confidence score (0.663) among candidates. Confirmed to exist in npm registry (E1), package has 64 versions (E2), and version 1.1.21 is a valid published version with no known vulnerabilities (E3). Published before SBOM timestamp 2026-11-12.

proposal.name: protobufjs
proposal.rationale: The SBOM declares protobufjs at version 7.6.6. E1 confirms the package exists in npm. E3 confirms version 7.6.6 was published before the SBOM timestamp and matches the declared version. It also has the highest probability (0.742) among candidates.

proposal.name: brace-expansion

proposal.name: zod
proposal.rationale: Version 4.6.7 is the most likely exact version based on: (1) it exists in the npm registry (E1), (2) it satisfies the declared range ^4.4.3 and was published before the SBOM timestamp (E2), and (3) it has the highest probability (0.641) among all candidates in the SBOM analysis.

proposal.name: ws
proposal.rationale: Version 8.22.1 is confirmed to exist in npm registry (E2), was available before SBOM timestamp 2026-11-12 (E1), and has no known vulnerabilities (E3). It is the highest probability candidate (0.298) in the current_candidates and matches the declared version in the SBOM.

proposal.name: minimatch
proposal.rationale: The SBOM declares minimatch@3.1.5 with purl pkg:npm/minimatch@3.1.5. Version 3.1.5 exists in the npm registry (E1) and is the most likely version among the 3.1.x candidates (E3) with a prior probability of 0.885, far exceeding 3.1.2 (0.112), 3.1.3 (0.003), and 3.1.4 (0.001). It was published before the SBOM timestamp of 2026-11-12.
